featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a British citizen who has decided to under-go dental implants and cosmetic procedures, namely blepharoplasty and liposuction on neck, chest and stomach. I have chosen India as my preferred destination - a country with highly qualified medical professionals offering procedures at very attractive costs. To this end, I chose Indmed Travel (a Medical Tourism Company in Mumbai) as my intermediary                                        – a review of Indmed website and some background research gave me assurances in their expertise, to arrange and coordinate my requirements with the medical professionals based in Mumbai and Delhi.

Doctor Amogh was my coordinator at Indmed. He forwarded me a list of implantologists and cosmetic surgeons that complied with my criteria, namely medics with some international experiences/training and with proven track record of meeting patients’ expectations. I thoroughly reviewed the listing and from which I have selected medics, who I believe will successfully fulfill my expectations in due course.

To summarise, I feel very happy to have chosen Indmed as my medical intermediary - I believe they  are professional and customers focussed organisation. Furthermore, I found Doctor Amogh to be diligent, knowledgeable, excellent communicator and very attentive to my expectations and criteria’s.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you very much Ash for giving us a chance to help you. Dr. Amogh is really attentive towards patients satisfaction. We all appreciate him at Indmed travel.

featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Sanika Ghag
featured_reviews.review_text:
NO, JUST A BIG FAT NO.

I recently visited Aditi Hospital for a MINOR surgery as recommended to me by Dr. Shrirang Yadwadkar (my surgeon). While I have nothing but good words and gratitude for Dr. Shrirang, the staff, the resident doctors and the overall administration at Aditi Hospital made my entire experience quite abysmal and displeasing.

The state of rooms post my operation was beyond terrible. The bed had weird stains and marks, the bed cover had stains, the bedsheets was that old state of white that happens after one too many washes and was smelling horrible, the bed and pillow was hard as a rock, the washroom had wires running through it and the structure in general looked like it would fall any minute - all this after paying for a PRIVATE ROOM (check attached photos).

But I think the real nail in the coffin was their hospitality, absolutely unhinged. We were given a room close to the nurses station, and it was noisy as hell. It was only me and my mom sleeping in the room and their staff - both male and female, would come in and out at of our room at their will, without knocking or without waiting for our approval. The administration staff is also not well versed with the mediclaim policies.

The worse is yet to come. 1 and 1/2 hour after my anaesthesia came off, a resident doctor came in to take my vitals then actually has handed me my phone and asked me to write a review - my operation was done on my right hand... No doctor, sister, nurse, anyone actually even asked once how my health was, just came in took my vitals and went. We were supposed to get discharged by 5 but the doctors kept us waiting citing that the OT summary wasn't provided by the surgeon so the discharge note could not be made. We told them to call the surgeon and ask for it and for 2 hours they didn't do so and kept us hanging. Finally, taking matters into my own hands, I had to call the surgeon myself and ask him to send the required data to the hospital staff. Even after this, no one has come in to explain me anything about my post-op care, diet, health precautions, etc.

Furthermore, when my mom went to ask about my post-op care, one nurse told her to visit the doc downstairs. Like, where is your hospitality? Asking a patient's family member to hunt for doctor's in your hospital and not actually taking the time to come and talk to your own patients?

Pissed at this treatment, I had to go and talk to their doctor who still had a very oh-I-don't-care about this attitude and was quite rude. I thought the day was past me, but upon reaching home I realised the doctors had left 2 ECG monitors still strapped on my chest - 12 hours post surgery.

If I could give a no star review to this hospital, I very well would.  If you are looking for patient care, hospitality, quiet and peaceful time at the hospital where you or your loved ones could blissfully recover, ADITI HOSPITAL IS NOT IT.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sanika Ghag,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent visit to Aditi Hospital. We are pleased to know that you had a positive experience with Dr. Shrirang Yadwadkar, whose clinical expertise and patient care are highly valued by our institution.
At the same time, we sincerely regret that certain aspects of your hospital stay did not meet your expectations. Patient comfort and safety remain our highest priority, and feedback such as yours helps us further improve our systems.
With regard to the concerns mentioned:
• Room Condition:
The rooms on the floor you were admitted to are among the most frequently utilized private rooms in the hospital due to the high surgical volume. All linen used in the hospital undergoes standard hospital-grade washing and disinfection protocols. However, we acknowledge your observation and the housekeeping and facility teams have been asked to review the room condition and ensure stricter monitoring of linen quality and room maintenance.
• Clinical Monitoring & Staff Visits:
Post-operative patients require regular monitoring of vitals and clinical parameters, which may require nursing or resident staff to enter the room multiple times. These visits are strictly for patient safety and recovery monitoring. Nevertheless, we have reminded our staff to maintain proper patient courtesy, including knocking before entering whenever feasible.
• OT Summary & Discharge Process:
The preparation of discharge documentation depends on operative notes and OT summaries, which are prepared after the completion of surgical procedures. Since surgeons are often engaged in ongoing surgeries or patient care in the operation theatre, there can occasionally be short delays in documentation. However, we appreciate your patience and are reviewing the discharge workflow to reduce waiting time wherever possible.
• Post-Operative Instructions:
Our standard protocol is that post-operative care instructions are explained by the ward doctor or nursing team and documented in the discharge summary, which is handed over at the time of discharge along with medication and diet instructions.
• Monitoring Equipment:
ECG monitoring patches are sometimes left temporarily in place for post-operative monitoring and are usually removed during final nursing rounds or discharge preparation. We regret if this caused you any inconvenience.
We also note from our internal records that your accompanying family members expressed satisfaction with the clinical care provided during the admission. Nevertheless, every patient's perception matters and we value the time you took to share your concerns.
Aditi Hospital has been serving the Mulund community for many years with a commitment to ethical clinical care, patient safety, and continuous improvement. Your feedback has been shared with our administrative and nursing leadership teams for review.
If you would like to discuss your experience further, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you directly and address any remaining concerns.
Wishing you a smooth and complete recovery.
Warm regards,
Administration Team
Aditi Hospital
Mulund (W), Mumbai

The way people can access medical care has changed in quite some ways recently, particularly in bustling metro cities like Mumbai. This article will show you how these services are provided, the right time to opt for them, and how sometimes hospital care is still required.

featured_reviews.name: Rihanna Sharif
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Docville - Doctor At Home Services enough for the exceptional care provided to my 80-year-old father. Thru Dr. Jesnoor Dayara who came to my house, I was so skeptical at first as I have never used a service like that . Dr. Jesnoor truly came like an angel, fully equipped wearing a PPE kit along with a  nurse and  with suitcase full of medical tools and emergency medication. Commendable!

She was incredibly patient, compassionate, and professional. Instead of rushing through the visit, she stayed for nearly 40 minutes, carefully monitoring my father's blood pressure and other symptoms until it returned to a safe range. She wrote a 4 pager medical diagnosis and medicines to be taken in a elegant handwriting.
Her dedication did not end there—she continued to follow up, monitored his progress, and provided thoughtful medical advice and appropriate medications.

What stood out most was the genuine care and empathy she showed. It's rare to find a doctor who combines medical expertise with such a kind heart.

Highly recommend Docville and especially Dr. Jesnoor Dayara to anyone looking for reliable, compassionate, and professional home healthcare services.
Top Class !!!
